stimuli.value: Nine cue types indicated monetary gain, monetary loss, or no response; a solid white square was presented as the target.

spans.text: At the cue period (b, bottom panel), one of nine cue types was presented: (1) gain of 0 yen, circle with no line; (2) gain of 20 yen, circle with one horizontal line; (3) gain of 100 yen, circle with two horizontal lines; (4) gain of 500 yen, circle with three horizontal lines; (5) loss of 0 yen, square with no line; (6) loss of 20 yen, square with one horizontal line; (7) loss of 100 yen, square with two horizontal lines; (8) loss of 500 yen, square with three horizontal lines; and (9) no response, triangle.
